WHAT: Two-layer timeout ensures Claude Code HTTP hook always gets a response
HOW:
1. Claude Code hook config: set timeout = 30 seconds
2. Server-side: setTimeout auto-deny fires at 25 seconds
3. 5 second buffer ensures server responds before Claude Code gives up
WHY: If server never responds, Claude Code hangs indefinitely or errors unpredictably
GOTCHA: Auto-deny (not auto-approve) on timeout — safer default for unattended/missed approvals
APPLIES TO: Any HTTP hook server built for Claude Code pre-tool-use or post-tool-use hooks
